name: DrunkPrime
subtitle: Your purifier, on your local Wi-Fi.
localizedDescription: View and manage compatible DrinkPrime water purifiers over a local Wi-Fi connection. Check water usage, remaining allowance, expiry and device readings. Save purifier profiles, scan QR codes, configure Wi-Fi and review parameter changes. Profiles and request history stay on your device.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scan the QR label on your purifier to save its identifier.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Connect directly to your purifier to read its status and send the changes you select.
